title: Decision tree output mapping
statement: Let $g$ be a map from an output set $\alpha$ to an output set $\beta$. Applying $g$ to the output labels of a finite decision tree replaces each leaf label $a$ by $g(a)$ and leaves the queried coordinates and branching structure unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A finite decision tree over a fixed set of available coordinates
